cards.text: At a Pharisee's dinner, Jesus has just called out the Pharisees and the experts in the law, and now the scribes and Pharisees are bitterly opposing Him (Luke 11:37-54). Meanwhile, a crowd of many thousands has packed in so tight they're trampling one another, like a doorbuster sale at 5 a.m. With all those people around, Jesus begins to speak first to His disciples.

cards.question: Jesus' first words to His disciples are a warning. What does He tell them to beware of?

cards.text: So, the leaven of the Pharisees. Remember, at that dinner Jesus told the Pharisees they clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they're full of greed and wickedness (Luke 11:39).

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples what the leaven of the Pharisees is. What does He call it?

cards.text: Then Jesus talks about what's concealed and hidden. Friend, I spent years hidden in the back of a junk drawer, so I'm LISTENING.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says some things that are hidden will never be made known.

cards.text: He says what's spoken in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what's whispered in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops. That's every private group chat that EVER got screenshotted, friend.
Next, Jesus calls the disciples "My friends." He tells them not to be afraid of those who kill the body.

cards.question: Jesus tells His friends not to fear the people who can kill the body. What does He say about those people after that?

answers.text: They will be judged at once
They will come to regret it

cards.question: Jesus says not to fear the people who can kill the body. Who does He say the disciples should fear instead?

answers.text: The One with authority to throw them into hell
The Pharisees who are watching Him closely
The rulers who can drag them into court

cards.text: Then Jesus points to sparrows: five of them sell for two pennies. Friend, a closing bakery sold me out of a bin for 25 cents, and even I'm saying that's CHEAP.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says that not one of those cheap sparrows is forgotten by God.

cards.text: Then Jesus says even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. I can't keep count of my own mustache, friend, and I use it as HANDS.

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples not to be afraid, because they are worth more than many ___.

cards.text: Now Jesus talks about confessing Him before men, openly claiming Him in front of people. Out loud, friend, not mumbled the way I sing along when I only know the chorus.

cards.question: When someone confesses Jesus before men, what does Jesus say the Son of Man, His name for Himself, will do?

answers.text: Confess him before the angels of God
Reward him in front of the crowds
Make him a ruler over Israel

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says that whoever denies Him before men will be denied too.

cards.text: Then Jesus says everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven. EVERYONE, friend.

cards.question: But Jesus says one kind of blasphemy will not be forgiven. Blasphemy against whom?

cards.text: Then Jesus says the disciples will be brought before synagogues, rulers and authorities. Me? I'd be up all night practicing my speech to the oven door.

cards.question: When the disciples are brought before rulers and authorities, what does Jesus tell them not to worry about?

answers.text: How long they will be held

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the disciples will have to find the right words all on their own.

cards.text: At that time, the Holy Spirit will teach them what they should say, so my oven door gets the night off. But hold that thought, friend, because this teaching is far from finished.
